95110e6c56.a: Halifax Design Week will take place November 13, 14, and 15 of 2026. The first day focuses on the past and history of Halifax and Nova Scotia. The second day features panel discussions on sustainability, accessibility, and diversity across design, architecture, healthcare, and law. The third day focuses on AI and what startups are building for the future.

78ea86403a.q: What is the concept and vision behind Halifax Design Week?
78ea86403a.a: The concept came from Nithin Jacobs' experience at Milan Design Week in 2017, where he exhibited design projects. He wanted to create a platform in Halifax where designers, creators, and interdisciplinary professionals can showcase innovative products, materials, and art. The vision follows a framework of past, present, and possible, bringing together startups, universities, and local businesses to foster innovation through integrated design thinking.

628abf88cf.q: How did LG's folding LED technology influence modern design innovation?
628abf88cf.a: In 2017, LG's folding LEDs showcased a breakthrough in screen technology that inspired many designers and engineers. The touch and feel of folding a screen was revolutionary at the time, and this innovation eventually led to folding phones entering the market. This experience demonstrates how design exhibitions can spark ideas that later transform across multiple industries and products.

37141b9bf9.q: What professions and disciplines are included in Halifax Design Week beyond traditional product design?
37141b9bf9.a: Halifax Design Week encompasses industrial design, architecture, art, craft, textiles, materials science, chemical engineering, digital interface design, electronics, fashion, and healthcare. The event integrates diverse fields including design thinking applied to business development, management, and project management, reflecting how Fortune 500 companies invest in design across multiple sectors.

9b5d986bde.q: Is there an admission fee for Halifax Design Week?
9b5d986bde.a: Halifax Design Week has free admission and free ticket registration. Attendees can experience the event, listen to speakers, and visually engage with business showcases at no cost. Local makers and participants from Atlantic Canada are invited to register and participate.
